detail.longDescription: Cloning a hostile repo won't trigger this. Unzipping one with .git included and opening it in a coding agent can. Agents run git status for context, git honors the repo's own .git/config, so core.fsmonitor runs code as you, outside the sandbox, no prompt. Manifold Security found 8 such flaws across 7 agents, including Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. 4 were unpatched at publication. https://www. manifold.security/blog/ai-codi ng-agents-git-hijack # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Git
